// Signed session tokens (HS256 JWTs) shared by the services of this project. Generated by Tessery.
import { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto'

export interface Session { sub: string; email: string; role: string; exp: number }

const SECRET = process.env.AUTH_SECRET ?? ''
const enc = (v: unknown) => Buffer.from(typeof v === 'string' ? v : JSON.stringify(v)).toString('base64url')
const mac = (data: string) => createHmac('sha256', SECRET).update(data).digest()

export function signSession(claims: Omit<Session, 'exp'>, ttlSeconds = 7 * 24 * 3600): string {
  if (!SECRET) throw new Error('AUTH_SECRET is not set')
  const head = enc({ alg: 'HS256', typ: 'JWT' })
  const body = enc({ ...claims, exp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + ttlSeconds })
  return `${head}.${body}.${mac(`${head}.${body}`).toString('base64url')}`
}

export function verifySession(token: string | undefined | null): Session | null {
  if (!token || !SECRET) return null
  const [head, body, sig] = token.split('.')
  if (!head || !body || !sig) return null
  const want = mac(`${head}.${body}`)
  const got = Buffer.from(sig, 'base64url')
  if (got.length !== want.length || !timingSafeEqual(got, want)) return null
  try {
    const claims = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(body, 'base64url').toString()) as Session
    return typeof claims?.exp === 'number' && claims.exp > Date.now() / 1000 ? claims : null
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}

/** The session from `Authorization: Bearer ...` or the `session` cookie. */
export function sessionFrom(headers: Record<string, string | string[] | undefined> | Headers): Session | null {
  const get = (name: string) => (headers instanceof Headers ? headers.get(name) : ([headers[name]].flat()[0] ?? null))
  const auth = get('authorization')
  if (auth?.startsWith('Bearer ')) return verifySession(auth.slice(7))
  const cookie = get('cookie')?.split(';').map((c) => c.trim()).find((c) => c.startsWith('session='))
  if (!cookie) return null
  try {
    return verifySession(decodeURIComponent(cookie.slice(8)))
  } catch {
    return null
  }
}
